conclusion: Warmup removes the first-request cold start and transient short-request outliers; p95 improves only 0.6-0.8 ms. The 800+ token requests are device-compute bound and unchanged. A full warmup pass costs ~5 min and still had one transient outlier; a 32-request short warmup gave a clean max (248 ms) with a ~5 s cost.
